why: A states Lemma 8.1 in the sheet form of the text's proof: for a sheet s : W → V with inverse σ and g(φ') = m(σ(t φ'), φ'), sc-smooth on t⁻¹(V) by condition (4) in sheet form (isScSmoothCompSheet), k ∘ h = Tg(h) when k lies over W. It adds the auxiliary sheet facts Tσ(Ts k) = k and h ∈ T(t⁻¹V). The project explicitly does not prove T(𝐗 ₛ×ₜ 𝐗) = T𝐗 _{Ts}×_{Tt} T𝐗. B states the lemma literally: v ↦ (Tpr₁ v, Tpr₂ v) is a bijection of Part I's tangent space of the fibred-product sub-M-polyfold onto the composable pairs, and Tm v = (Tpr₁ v) ∘ (Tpr₂ v). That identification is missing from A as a statement, but it follows from existing project infrastructure; this file proves it in A'_to_B. Injectivity holds because pr₂ is an sc-diffeomorphism near each point (isScDiffeoOn_snd_fibredProduct + IsScDiffeoOn.tangentMap). Surjectivity takes v = (Tpr₂|TU)⁻¹(h) and gets Tpr₁ v = k by fibre injectivity tangent_ext. The bridge tm_eq_tg (on U = {ψ ∈ W, t φ ∈ V} one has m = g ∘ pr₂, so Tm v = Tg(Tpr₂ v), by the chain rule on open sets) converts each side's composition formula into the other's. A_to_B uses the hypothesis' tComp_eq_tangentMapOn, mem_tangentPreimage_tgt and sheet form. B_to_A gets tComp_eq_tangentMapOn from B's surjectivity and Tm clause, and the sheet form of (4) from B's smoothness of m via isScSmoothComp_iff_sheet. It re-proves outright, one line each, the two facts that concern only a sheet of s and are not consequences of B (tangentMapOn_srcInv_tSrc, mem_tangentPreimage_tgt), and takes lemma_8_1's base-point/source clauses from tComp_spec (V8_1). Universes at 0.
B_issue: B's identification T(𝐗 ₛ×ₜ 𝐗) ≅ T𝐗 _{Ts}×_{Tt} T𝐗 is a bijection of sets only, not of M-polyfolds; its author says so. This is sufficient for the lemma's formula.
